paper_title: Laying the Foundation First Investigating the Generalization from   Atomic Skills to Complex Reasoning Tasks
caption: Error analysis on Vanilla model (left) and HCL model (right).
model_annotation: This pie chart represents an error analysis of responses generated by two models, labeled “Atomic Skill Fail” and “Correct,” alongside “Reason Error” and “Question Misunderstood.” The chart contains four distinct slices, each representing a type of error observed in the models' responses. The largest slice, colored in a light teal, represents “Atomic Skill Fail” with an approximate proportion of 68.0%, while the second largest slice, colored in a medium teal, displays “Correct” with approximately 21.0%. A smaller slice colored in a light gray represents “Reason Error,” with approximately 14.0%, and the smallest slice colored in a light lavender represents “Question Misunderstood” with approximately 10.0%. The chart includes percentage labels displayed directly within each slice, and there is no accompanying legend. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their size.
